tasks.title: cURL & WhatWeb
tasks.description: Inspect HTTP headers for server versions and use WhatWeb to fingerprint underlying CMS or frameworks.

tasks.title: Nmap HTTP Scripts
tasks.description: Run default HTTP NSE scripts to check for obvious vulnerabilities or interesting endpoints.

tasks.title: Feroxbuster (Recursive)
tasks.description: Aggressive, recursive directory discovery filtering specific status codes.

tasks.title: Gobuster (Extensions)
tasks.description: Targeted directory brute-forcing looking for specific file extensions.

tasks.title: Ffuf (VHost Fuzzing)
tasks.description: Fuzz the Host header to find hidden virtual hosts. Be sure to replace the -fs (filter size) flag value with the default response size.

tasks.title: EyeWitness (Visual Recon)
tasks.description: Take screenshots of discovered web pages, identify default credentials, and categorize them into an HTML report.

tasks.title: Gowitness (Visual Recon)
tasks.description: If you have a large list of discovered URLs, use gowitness to screenshot all of them and view them in a local web interface.

tasks.title: Basic SQLi Probing
tasks.description: Test input fields and URL parameters for simple SQL injection vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: SQLMap Automated Exploitation
tasks.description: Automate injection point discovery and dumping once manual probing confirms a vulnerable form or parameter.

tasks.title: Blind SQLi to RCE (MSSQL xp_cmdshell Chain)
tasks.description: When a login form is vulnerable to blind/time-based SQLi against an MSSQL backend (confirmed with WAITFOR DELAY), stack queries to enable and call xp_cmdshell for command execution. Base64-encode a PowerShell reverse shell for the final payload since quoting inside the injected string is limited.

tasks.title: Exposed .git Extraction
tasks.description: If /.git is accessible, dump the repository locally and scan it for hardcoded secrets. gitleaks/git log -S won't catch everything, so also walk the full commit history manually — secrets are often removed in a later 'cleanup'/'security update' commit but still sit in an earlier one's diff.
commands: python3 -m venv git-env && source git-env/bin/activate && pip install git-dumper

tasks.title: Hydra Form Brute-Forcing
tasks.description: Brute-force an HTTP POST login form. Adjust the URI path, username/password variables, and failure message string.

tasks.title: HTTP Basic Auth Brute-Forcing
tasks.description: Distinct from a POST login form — a 401 response with a WWW-Authenticate header means credentials go in the request itself, not a form body. Check quickly with curl before scripting a brute-force.

tasks.title: Burp Intruder Form Brute-Forcing
tasks.description: Use when Hydra can't handle the form (CSRF token per request, session cookie required, non-standard failure condition). Capture the login request in Burp, send to Intruder, mark the password field as the payload position, and use 'Grep - Match' on the failure string to spot the one response that differs.
commands: # Proxy the login POST through Burp, send to Intruder (Ctrl+I)
# Attack type: Sniper, payload position on the password parameter only
# Payloads tab: load users.txt or rockyou.txt as the payload list
# Options tab: Grep - Match on the known failure string (e.g. 'Data error') to filter successes

tasks.title: Tomcat / JBoss Enumeration
tasks.description: Scan and exploit default credentials on Tomcat or JBoss managers.

tasks.title: Log4Shell Probing
tasks.description: Test input fields or headers for Log4j vulnerability.

tasks.title: Text4Shell (CVE-2022-42889) Probing
tasks.description: Apache Commons Text <=1.9 evaluates string interpolation prefixes like 'script:' by default. Test any field that might be passed through StringSubstitutor, then chain to a download-and-execute RCE.
